content_text:
A 1000W LED set to full warm (below 3200K) for sunset
might
be enough, it really depends on how dark it is outside and how far away you need to put the light out the window. If you can darken the view beyond with, let’s say, a Double Net scrim on a frame, that might help the balance. Or wait until dusk or for heavier overcast weather. If it is a
bright
overcast day then the 1000W LED might not overpower the natural daylight enough. It’s hard to say, it’s a bit like asking if a 5K tungsten fresnel outside a window is bright enough for a sunset effect — half the time, it is.
I just by coincidence was looking at this shot in “Barry Lyndon”, which used I think a 10K tungsten fresnel outside the window for a sunset effect (the light is barely visible for a few frames as the camera pans 180 degrees.)
